sql.value: select t.id, t.name, t.description, t.category, t.scene, t.content, t.variables, t.current_version, t.enable_status, t.sort, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time from ai_prompt_template t where t.is_deleted=0 #[and t.name like :name] #[and t.category = :category] #[and t.scene = :scene] #[and t.enable_status = :enableStatus] order by t.sort desc, t.id desc

select v.id, v.template_id, v.version, v.content, v.variables, v.change_note, v.create_by, v.create_time from ai_prompt_template_version v where 1=1 #[and v.template_id = :templateId] #[and v.version = :version] order by v.version desc
